California Gov. Gavin Newsom plans to commute all death sentences, NBC News reports.
Democratic socialist Nithya Raman wins Los Angeles mayoral race over incumbent Karen Bass, The Guardian reports.

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has signed off on the National Guard ramping up its presence in the nation’s capital in military vehicles and boats as troops deepen their integration with local law enforcement, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
